candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 应用强有力的尽职调查措施识别红旗信号信号，包括客户背景调查和交易监控
candidate_pool.en_quote: To identify these red flags, it is important to apply robust due diligence measures. These might include comprehensive customer background checks, and transaction monitoring systems which detect suspicious patterns of activity related to high-value assets.

kg.source_core_point_title_zh: 高价值资产洗钱风险与尽职调查措施
kg.target_core_point_title_zh: 高价值资产洗钱风险与尽职调查措施

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 犯罪分子可利用高价值资产洗钱，将非法资金转化为看似合法的投资或购买昂贵物品。
candidate_pool.en_quote: A risk associated with high-value assets is that criminals can use these assets to launder money. Criminals convert illicit funds into seemingly legitimate investments or use them to purchase expensive items.
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: High-value asset money laundering risk

kg.source_core_point_title_zh: 高价值资产洗钱风险与尽职调查措施
kg.target_core_point_title_zh: 高价值资产洗钱风险与尽职调查措施

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 金融机构必须了解高价值资产的性质以有效评估风险。
candidate_pool.en_quote: Financial institutions must understand the nature of these assets to effectively assess the risks.
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: obligation to understand asset nature for risk assessment

kg.source_core_point_title_zh: 高价值资产洗钱风险与尽职调查措施
kg.target_core_point_title_zh: 高价值资产洗钱风险与尽职调查措施

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 技术在海量客户和交易监控中发挥关键作用，支持金融犯罪防控监测与调查。
candidate_pool.en_quote: This module covers the critical role technology plays in AFC monitoring and investigations due to the large volume of customers and transactions that organizations need to monitor.
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Role of technology in AFC monitoring

kg.source_core_point_title_zh: AFC监控与调查技术概述
kg.target_core_point_title_zh: AFC监控与调查技术概述

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 交易监控是开户后持续观察客户交易以识别异常或非法活动。
candidate_pool.en_quote: Transaction monitoring is the continuous observation of customer transactions after onboarding to identify unusual or illicit activity and the risk it might have to the organization.
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: definition of transaction monitoring

kg.source_core_point_title_zh: 交易监控
kg.target_core_point_title_zh: 交易监控

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 本模块介绍交易监控系统的最佳实践、警报评估、调查类型及系统调优
candidate_pool.en_quote: In this module, we will explore industry best practices and expectations for TM systems. You will gain skills to evaluate transaction monitoring alerts and understand the various types of investigations that might follow. This module will also cover best practices in data analysis and documentation, equipping you to conduct thorough AML investigations, and understand system tuning.
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Module introduction and learning objectives

kg.source_core_point_title_zh: 交易监控系统简介
kg.target_core_point_title_zh: 交易监控系统简介

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 监控技术从基于规则的系统演变为情境监控，整合网络分析和AI以在更广背景下审视交易。
candidate_pool.en_quote: Over time, this technology has evolved from rules-based systems to contextual monitoring, integrating network analysis and AI to view transactions in a broader context.
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Evolution of monitoring technology

kg.source_core_point_title_zh: AFC监控与调查技术概述
kg.target_core_point_title_zh: AFC监控与调查技术概述

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 交易监控在交易发生期间或之后检测异常或可疑活动。
candidate_pool.en_quote: Transaction monitoring detects unusual or suspicious activity during or after transactions occur.
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: definition of transaction monitoring

kg.source_core_point_title_zh: 交易监控
kg.target_core_point_title_zh: 交易监控

candidate_pool.knowledge_zh: 制裁、政治敏感人物和负面媒体筛查在开户前及持续进行，交易监控仅在开户后开始。
candidate_pool.en_quote: Sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening occur before onboarding and continue on an ongoing basis. Transactions monitoring begins only after onboarding.
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Timing of screening vs transaction monitoring

kg.target_core_point_title_zh: 交易监控

candidate_pool.en_quote: Real-time and batch payment screening help prevent sanctions evasion and detect financial crime.
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: Real-time and batch payment screening

candidate_pool.en_quote: For example, large transactions, frequent transfers, or transactions involving high-risk jurisdictions might trigger alerts for further investigation.
candidate_pool.knowledge_en: examples of transactions triggering alerts

kg.source_core_point_title_zh: 内部报告与升级流程
kg.target_core_point_title_zh: 内部报告与升级流程

evidence_cards.reason: 该单元明确定义交易监控为监控可疑交易活动，直接命中题干要求的交易监控系统核心能力。
该单元说明交易监控系统是帮助金融机构检测可疑交易模式的技术框架，直接支持选项A的识别异常情况功能。

option_analysis.basis: 选项A完整描述了交易监控系统的核心功能，教材多个单元直接将其定义为监控交易并识别可疑活动或异常模式，与题干意图高度吻合，故为正确答案。
教材中无任何单元提及交易监控系统应具备自动翻译文档的功能，该选项与交易监控系统的定义无关。

evidence_cards.reason: 该单元提到链下分析可整合社交媒体资料，但这是独立于交易监控系统的外部分析手段，并非交易监控系统本身应具备的能力。

option_analysis.basis: 整合社交媒体资料属于链下分析或情报整合范畴，教材未将其归入交易监控系统的核心功能，因此不能作为该系统应具备的能力。

evidence_cards.reason: 该单元指出监管报告与联络职能负责提交SAR和CTR，属于独立的二线防线职能，并非交易监控系统本身的能力，间接反驳了选项D。

option_analysis.basis: 提交监管报告是反洗钱报告职能的工作，交易监控系统负责生成警报和识别异常，不直接承担提交报告的任务，因此不属于其应备能力。

question_intent.intent_reasoning: 题干直接询问强大交易监控系统的能力范围，属于对概念定义的考查，不涉及流程顺序或最佳动作限制。

judgment_standard.standard_explanation: 题目要求判断交易监控系统的核心能力，应依据教材对交易监控系统的直接定义和功能描述进行匹配，而非将其他反洗钱职能误认为交易监控系统的能力。
judgment_standard.decisive_rule: 优先匹配教材中明确描述交易监控系统功能的单元；若选项涉及其他反洗钱职能但未出现在交易监控系统定义中，则不视为该系统的应备能力。

competing_option_analysis.why_each_is_plausible: 选项A直接对应交易监控系统的核心功能；选项D中的监管报告与反洗钱整体工作相关，容易使人误认为交易监控系统也应具备提交报告的能力。
competing_option_analysis.decisive_dimension: 教材对交易监控系统的功能定义仅限于监控和识别可疑活动，而监管报告提交属于独立的报告职能，不属于交易监控系统本身的能力范畴。
